pr.body:
Closes #265

## Changes

- Add an isolated Control Prisma client, migration and reverse SQL.
- Serialize audit appends in the caller transaction. Grant the runtime role SELECT plus EXECUTE on the fixed-search-path append function and deny direct table writes.
- Export small sequence/hash checkpoints and independently verify the captured prefix. Store identifiers and changed-field names without storing field values.

## TDD and verification

- RED: the test-first integration suite failed on the missing Control Prisma client before storage implementation.
- GREEN: scoped typecheck and lint passed. Nine Node 22.12 tests passed against disposable PostgreSQL 16, including the ci-gate fixture path that creates a dedicated database on the existing PostgreSQL service.
- Verified transaction rollback, concurrent appends, direct modification and PUBLIC execute denial, SQL-level input constraints, checkpoint tamper detection and down migration on the fixture. Audit module coverage was 100% lines and 96.30% branches.
- The frozen pnpm install passed. The lockfile adds only the existing Prisma resolutions to the Control workspace importer.
